_doc: Charge weapons: the weapon card shows a charge-time slider from min to max seconds. points = [seconds, damage multiplier] from each wiki page's Detailed Weapon Statistics (linear between points). steps = which mode (projectile and explosion) fires from that charge time on; ref = the multiplier the mode's listed damage / durable already include. Only the projectile's damage scales; explosions switch with the step.

plas-45-epoch.note: Wiki charge table: P at 1.00 s ×1.00, P3 at 2.50 s ×1.94, P3 at 2.60 s ×2.00. Holding past full charge overcharges and the gun explodes.

plas-101-purifier.note: Wiki: projectile damage ×0.50 at minimum charge (0.1 s) to ×1.00 at full charge (1 s). The explosion doesn't scale; only a full charge fires the big explosion.

rs-422-railgun.note: Wiki charge table: ×1.00 at 0.45 s, ×1.03 at 0.50 s, ×2.50 at 3.00 s; AP stays the same. Unsafe mode explodes when the meter hits 100% (3 s); Safe mode holds at 60%.

plas-15-loyalist.note: Wiki charge table: P1 at 0.01 s ×0.50, P2 at 0.75 s ×0.62, P2 at 3.00 s ×1.00 (base 150 / 75). P2 carries the big 225 explosion.
